description:
The store: workspaces with listings in it (exactly what /store shows), each with its owner, conventions,
        listing count and listing paths. Search the listings with query_index(scope='store'); every file in public
        workspaces is scope='public'. (Without a token, GET /store shows the listings as markdown.)

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

convention.description: Only public workspaces using this convention. Optional.
convention.title: Convention

name: browse_store
